root_cause.text: In the `amdgpu_userq_vm_validate` function of the DRM AMDGPU driver, the error handling path directs execution to `unlock_all` which calls `drm_exec_fini()` a second time on the same `drm_exec` object after it was already finalized earlier in the `new_addition` code path, violating the non-idempotent nature of the cleanup function.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies the error jump condition `if (ret) goto unlock_all;` to `if (ret) goto free_ranges;` in `amdgpu_userq_vm_validate`, thereby skipping the `drm_exec_fini(&exec)` call at the `unlock_all` label as described in the CVE explanation regarding double invocation.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement at line 1183 calls drm_exec_fini() prematurely in the new_addition code path. When an error occurs later in the function, execution jumps to unlock_all which calls drm_exec_fini() again on the same &exec object. Since drm_exec_fini() is not idempotent, this double-finalization violates its contract and can lead to use-after-free or double-free vulnerabilities.
